adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in addGuests.handler.ts line 158, `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)` gets the credentials of the requesting user (who could be an attendee), not the booking organizer. The EventManager is then initialized with these credentials. When an attendee adds guests, they won't have the organizer's calendar credentials, so `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` will fail to update the organizer's calendar. The code should use the organizer's credentials (booking.user) instead of ctx.user's credentials for calendar synchronization.
